findings.location: frozen-reference-r001.json price_feasibility_samples.quote_panel_timestamp and data_definition; protocol Practical source feasibility
findings.finding: The frozen NFLX and SPY timestamp snippets join a regular-session timestamp to the following after-hours price, while XLC loses an available timestamp. The history tables explicitly identify S&P Global Market Intelligence and daily after-close updates; the general Nasdaq UTP 15-minute quote description does not establish the history tables are that feed or available 15 minutes after close.
evidence: NFLX raw header: regular close 70.30 at October 9 16:00 EDT; separately after-hours 70.32 at 19:59 EDT. Daily Close is 70.30.
SPY raw header: regular close 778.57 at October 9 16:00; separately after-hours 778.59 at 19:51 EDT. Daily Close is 778.57.
XLC raw header: 110.38, October 9 16:00 EDT, market closed. Daily Close is 110.38.
All three history footers identify S&P Global and daily after-close updates. General data-sources page separately discusses CBOE real-time quotes and delayed consolidated Nasdaq UTP open/close.
findings.proposed_correction: In a preserved-input amendment, record each regular close value, timestamp/time-zone basis and separate after-hours value/time where supplied. Mark no observed regular-close disagreement in these samples. Attribute historical rows to their explicit S&P footer and keep general quote-feed information separate. Retain historical session dates and actual retrieval/first-observed availability; make no 15-minute historical-row publication guarantee. Explicitly reject a future same-session same-basis conflict pending resolution rather than treating after-hours as conflicting close.

findings.location: protocol One falsifiable primary economic hypothesis; Daily-resolution response design
findings.finding: The economic forecast horizon FY2027-2029 is specified, but H has no fixed adjudication date or eligible-evidence cutoff. D20 is called the primary price persistence/reversal endpoint only. Recording availability timestamps without defining the information set eligible to decide H leaves an investigator free to use later favourable disclosures to settle the original Q3 hypothesis or move its assessment date.
evidence: H requires forward source support and permits the interview to change classification, but specifies neither a final economic classification time nor frozen intermediate classification records.
D1/D2/D5 mark information sets and D20 is a price endpoint; no instruction excludes information first available after a chosen economic cutoff from the primary H adjudication.
findings.proposed_correction: Predeclare the primary H adjudication cutoff and the allowed source/availability boundary. One adequate design is primary H as of D1 close using release/interview and genuinely available follow-on evidence, with separately labelled D2/D5/D20 updates; another is explicitly designate D20 final H with frozen prior classifications. Choose before the event, preserve unresolved at the cutoff when evidence is insufficient, and exclude later evidence from retroactively changing the primary label. Any later economic change must distinguish Q3 evidence from intervening new developments. No numerical model update is required.

findings.location: protocol causal interface and Supported conditionally criterion; accepted framework r002 Cash bridge, commitments and funding
findings.finding: The displayed interface ends after recurring acquisition cash and deducts interest but no principal or refinancing/funding requirement, yet calls itself the accepted reference interface for owner cash. The accepted r002 cash-franchise framework deducts scheduled principal and tests an explicit opening-liquidity condition. The broad reference to financing offsets and a later current-value bridge does not expressly require that funding reconciliation before classifying a durable per-claim owner-cash improvement.
evidence: Protocol formula: recurring OI through acquisition cash, including cash interest, but omitting scheduled principal/net financing and liquidity reconciliation.

Accepted r002 specifies 2027-2029 principal payments, no assumed refinancing or new borrowing to fund distributions, and the conditional opening reserve. Those are unchanged baseline constraints, not newly proposed economic assumptions.

A positive recurring pre-principal cash direction can coexist with a larger debt-service need or failed funding condition; the latter cannot be labelled funded distributable owner-cash improvement solely from the displayed formula.
findings.proposed_correction: Label the displayed interface as recurring pre-principal operating-to-equity cash, then explicitly carry the existing debt-principal/service schedule, any independently evidenced refinancing costs and claims, liquidity reserves and funding continuity into H support. If debt/funding changes are unknown and could overturn the per-claim conclusion, classify unresolved. Do not subtract debt twice, add borrowing as free owner cash, or rebuild the accepted model. It is enough to demonstrate baseline financing/funding still holds for the claimed revision or document the bounded offset.
